page.content:
Eurasian grape species behind nearly all fine-wine varieties.

How Vitis vinifera connects

  • Topic: Wine — Vitis vinifera is the grape species behind nearly all fine wine.
  • Item: Cabernet Sauvignon — Cabernet Sauvignon is a Vitis vinifera variety.
  • Item: Pinot Noir — Pinot Noir is a Vitis vinifera variety.
  • Item: Chardonnay — Chardonnay is a Vitis vinifera variety.
  • Event: Phylloxera — Phylloxera destroyed ungrafted Vitis vinifera vineyards across Europe.

What is Vitis vinifera?

Vitis vinifera is the wine grape: Cabernet, Pinot, Chardonnay, Riesling. Phylloxera forced it onto American rootstocks; the scions stayed vinifera.
